extDesc.message: Highlight & annotate any web page. Marks survive reloads and infinite scroll. Export to Obsidian / Markdown. No account, no server.

actionTitle.message: Toggle highlight panel (first click also enables this site)

unsupported.message: This browser does not support the CSS Custom Highlight API (needs Chrome/Edge 105+).

grantDenied.message: Permission denied. Click the icon again to allow this site.

notWebPage.message: Highlighting only works on normal http(s) pages.

uiNothing.message: No highlights on this page yet

uiEmptyHint.message: Select some text, or press Alt+H

uiOrphanTag.message: Original text not found (your data is kept)

libBackupTip.message: Full backup — use it to restore on a new computer or browser

libRestoreTip.message: Restore from a backup file. Only adds — never overwrites existing highlights

libEmpty.message: No highlights yet. Open any web page and click the extension icon.

libPickPage.message: Pick a page on the left

libOrphanNoJump.message: Original text not found — cannot jump

libJumpHint.message: Click to jump to this spot in the source

errNotJson.message: This file is not valid JSON — you may have picked the wrong one.

errNotBackup.message: This does not look like a Shuhen backup (no pages list).

expOrphaned.message: (original text not found — the site may have changed)

swNoUrl.message: Cannot read the current page URL. Reload the page and click the icon again; chrome:// and store pages are not supported.

swPermGesture.message: (a "user gesture" error means an await slipped in before the click)
